name: code-review
description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs at a given effort level. Use when the user asks to review code, a PR, a diff, or a branch.

name: simplify
description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only; it does not hunt for bugs.

name: security-review
description: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch.

name: claude-api
description: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK: model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration. Use whenever the prompt names Claude or Anthropic models or SDKs, asks about an LLM's pricing/model choice/limits/caching, or the task is LLM-shaped (agent, MCP, tool definitions, RAG, LLM-judge, summarize/classify/extract with a model) with the provider unstated.

name: artifact-design
description: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts (published HTML pages, apps, dashboards, reports hosted on claude.ai). Load before writing any artifact.

name: artifact-diagramming
description: Diagramming know-how for Artifacts: when a picture earns its place, how to draw one that shows the real mechanism, inline-SVG mechanics legible in both themes.

name: artifact-capabilities
description: Runtime capabilities a published Artifact page can be granted: reading live or connected data, remembering what people do on it (poll, sign-up sheet, checklist), shared state across viewers, knowing who is viewing, asking Claude, storing files, downloads.

name: dataviz
description: Use whenever creating any chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization in any medium: HTML/React artifact, inline SVG, matplotlib/plotly/d3/Recharts code, PNG. Covers chart form, color palettes, stat tiles, sparklines, heatmaps, legends, axes, tooltips.

name: update-config
description: Configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json: hooks for automated behaviors ('from now on when X', 'each time X'), permissions ('allow X'), env vars, hook troubleshooting, settings.json/settings.local.json changes.

name: keybindings-help
description: Customize Claude Code keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json.

name: fewer-permission-prompts
description: Scan transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

name: loop
description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. check the deploy every 5 minutes, keep running a command repeatedly). Not for one-off tasks.

name: schedule
description: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule, or a one-time scheduled run ('run this once at 3pm', 'remind me tomorrow').

name: workflow-authoring
description: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically: script API, gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples.

name: run
description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app rather than just tests.

name: init
description: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation.
